def: compare the base of G43 (ἀγκάλη)); a receptacle

occurrences.text: Which, when it was full, they drew to shore, and sat down, and gathered the good into vessels, but cast the bad away.
But the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
